model_annotation: The chart represents the distribution of different stimuli types, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into 9 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (28.5%, red), Press Release (21.9%, yellow), External News Article (13.1%, green), Interview (10.2%, dark blue), Organizational Report (8.8%, light purple) and Event Posting (8.8%, purple), Organizational Website (6.6%, light blue), Social Media Post (1.5%, light green), and Intra-agency news article (0.7%, orange). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown outside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a specific way, with the labels simply placed adjacent to their respective sections.
